notes.text: "Recorded on the Cargo 16 tracks mobile and mixt at Cargo Studios [...] Thanx to

for his sound (?) advice. It was recorded in Liverpool Norwich and London during the August '79 free tour"

First pressing, with disc labels on side 1 with Charly mascot and side 2 with track listings for both sides and 'Manufactured & distributed by Pye Records (Sales) Ltd'
Lower portion of back cover says -  "Charly Music Ltd. Sleeve printed and made in England by Gothic Print Finishers Ltd. London SE9 2EQ. Distributed by Sparten Records Ltd."
